spatial_sc_rnaseq_integration.sc_rnaseq_: File — scRNA-seq reference AnnData used as the Cell2location deconvolution reference for all spatial samples
spatial_sc_rnaseq_integration.spatial_vi: Array[SpatialVisiumProject] (optional, default = []) — each entry: { asap_team_id, asap_dataset_id, asap_dataset_doi_url, samples (Array[SpatialVisiumSample]), raw_data_bucket, staging_data_buckets }. SpatialVisiumSample: { sample_id (String), qc_adata_object (File) } — from spatial_visium preprocess.qc_adata_objects
spatial_sc_rnaseq_integration.sc_rnaseq_: File? (optional) — pre-computed inf_aver.csv.gz from a previous run. When provided, Stage 1 NB regression is skipped for all samples. When omitted, Stage 1 is trained from sc_rnaseq_final_adata_object.
spatial_sc_rnaseq_integration.n_cells_pe: Int (optional, default = 8) — Cell2location N_cells_per_location prior; 8 for brain Visium.
spatial_sc_rnaseq_integration.detection_: Int (optional, default = 100) — Cell2location detection rate prior (20–200).
spatial_sc_rnaseq_integration.max_epochs: Int (optional, default = 250) — NB regression training epochs.
Int (optional, default = 30000) — Cell2location spatial mapping epochs.
